explanation: Context: erdosproblems.com/595 asks whether there is an infinite K4-free graph that is not a countable union of triangle-free graphs. This textbook-tagged sanity check states that the complete graph on Fin 4 is not K4-free (¬ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 4)).CliqueFree 4), which is trivially true (⊤ on four vertices is K4) and is proved in the file. It correctly illustrates that the CliqueFree 4 hypothesis is the intended 'contains no K4' condition. Faithful.
